description: Purchase orders and vendor spend at or above the approval threshold require an on-file approval before spend is incurred. Spend at or above the dual-approval threshold requires two independent approvals.

policy_references.citation: Barbados Public Procurement Act, 2021 (Act No. 30 of 2021)
policy_references.authority: Office of the Chief Procurement Officer, Barbados
policy_references.notes: Requires vendor registration with the Chief Procurement Officer and states the CARICOM Protocol on Procurement prevails in case of conflict. Does not specify a numeric approval-dollar threshold, so single_approval_amount/dual_approval_amount remain internal-policy values, not regulatory citations.

policy_references.citation: Protocol on Procurement for the Caribbean Community
policy_references.notes: Regional procurement harmonization instrument referenced by the Barbados Public Procurement Act, 2021.

Sets single_approval_amount and dual_approval_amount. No numeric regulatory floor was found for these values, so validate_no_internal_policy_conflicts has nothing to check against yet for this control.
